notes.title: My new game Zefyr is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🎉Finally, it’s here ✨ After 12 years of crazy and naïve solo dev, my game Zefyr is officially released!

👇 Get it now ! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990
I’m incredibly happy, grateful, and super stressed at the same time. I truly hope you’ll enjoy it! Here’s some quick info:

1 — Please leave a positive review 
...if you enjoyed the game or course! It really helps a lot to boost visibility and reach more players.

2 — Support Bundles Available
For those who want to support the project even more, I’ve created a few bundles that you can all find on the game page:

 Zefyr Soundtrack Edition: Game + soundtrack
 Zefyr Supporter Edition: Game + soundtrack + artworks + HD in-game paintings + the very first build from 12 years ago
 All My Games: Zefyr + Slide (racing game with cute animals) + Silent Night (ride Santa’s sleigh in a chill scoring game)
 All My Games Supporter Edition: Everything above (all games/soundtracks/supporter packs)

Feel free to choose one of these instead of the base edition!

3 — Playable on Steam Deck
The game runs well on Steam Deck, even if it doesn't have the official badge yet. More details about game settings here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1344990/view/542229787451589252

4 — Follow me
If you don't want to miss anything of my future updates and upcoming games, you can:

 Follow my Steam dev page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds
 Follow me on Discord, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Threads, Instagram, and more: https://linktr.ee/oneiricworlds


🙏Thank you SO much for the amazing support over the years.🙏 
Your feedback and kind messages truly kept me going.

Wishing you all the best — take care, and see you soon with updates and fixes!
Have a wonderful day (and please don’t forget to leave a review!)

Mathias, the (tired) dev

notes.title: MASSIVE CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is a MASSIVE update of Slide, Animal Race! I tried to listen to all the feedback you gave me. I hope you'll like it!

Main improvements:

 4 new tracks (Ocre Canyon, The Wave, Boreal Whales, Smooth Dunes) (10 tracks total)
 2 new characters (Raccoon & Eagle) (8 animals total)
 12 concurrents on each track
 Relooking of minimaps icons
 New & more understandable victory screen with race timings
 AI reworking for a better difficulty balance
 A new track for the demo (Diplodocus Desert instead of Dragons of Aurora)


Other improvements:

 Nice smoke FX in desert races
 Sound & music rebalancing
 Larger tracks for the difficult levels Pirate Cove & Dragons of Aurora
 Fix lots of bad respawn bugs
 Breakable lanterns in Lantern Festival
 Readability improvements: black outline on animals, remove useless random FX, rework assets positioning on some tracks
 Better gravity and orientation management during jumps
 Nicer animal selection screen
 Improvement of some animal models
 Thin black line to separate each player subscreen
 Slight gameplay adjustment on slowing grass, bombs & lightning
 Polish on some feedback (slowing grass, lightning & speeder)
 Many fixes & optimisations

Of course, it's not finished, I plan to add more content in the future (tracks, animals, maybe game modes...). 

But for now, the price stays the same!

If you like all this, don't hesitate to leave a review on the store, it helps a lot!

Peace!

notes.title: 🐢 Slide, Animal Race 🐬 is AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

📢Today is the big day! 📢

🐢 Slide, Animal Race 🐬 finally comes to release after 1 year of work! I hope you'll like it :) Here's a little trailer to celebrate:

[previewyoutube=mh4fYXY6SxU;full][/previewyoutube]

You can check the game here : Slide, Animal Race Steam Page

It's been quite a journey to get there, and I learnt a lot in many different areas in the process (music, marketing, animation, level design, whatever, you name it...). 

🙏Thanks a lot to everyone for all the feedbacks, the tests, the discussions, the cheering up... 🙏

For reminders: 🐢 Slide, Animal Race 🐬 is a local multiplayer race game with cute animals, for little and big kids. In this game, you can:

 Play up to 8 friends in split-screen
 Play quick & fun races
 Ride cute animals
 Dive to avoid obstacles and gain boosts
 Use bonuses & power-ups to outrun the horde
 Find hidden shortcuts
 Discover dreamy tracks
 Play with younger players thanks to driving/riding assistance options


As I'm pretty much an unknown developer, don't hesitate to share this with your gamer, streamer or incredibly generous millionaire friends :)
I would greatly appreciate it!

Of course, the demo will remain free for everyone to test. If you're interested in the backstage stuff and making ofs, don't hesitate to check out and subscribe to my dev blog: http://www.oneiricworlds.com/en

Have fun, keep playing & making games, and take care :)

notes.title: Slide demo is arriving on Steam on October, 7th
notes.content:
Description
In Slide, you can ride cute animals to race against your friends through dreamy tracks. Master the dive to avoid obstacles and gain boosts, explore environments to find hidden shortcuts, use power-ups to outrun the horde. Or you can just take a tour and enjoy the view, while listening to the sympho-ethnic soundtrack. That's up to you. The game is playable up to 8 friends (or enemies) in local split-screen on Windows, Linux and MacOS. It is also accessible to beginners and kids thanks to auto-pilot options; but to win the race, you'll truly have to master the diving mechanics and many more. 

The Demo
The upcoming demo will showcase 1 track among clouds, 1 playable animal (a turtle) and up to 4 players.

Developer
Slide is developed by solo indie game developer Mathias Fontmarty. Mathias likes coding, drawing and making music. So what's better than creating video games to do all this at the same time? After years of learning by himself, he thought it was time to share his games for real, in the real world, for real people to play them. So he created "Oneiric Worlds", a game studio that aims at making inspiring and feel-good video games... because that's what he likes!

Story
Slide was first developed as a mini-game for "A Thief's Melody", a cartoon 3D adventure/stealth game currently in development at the studio. It evolved so much that it reached a point where it could be a full game by itself. Both games share the same world and the same contemplative atmosphere, as well as a focus on animals and nature.
